behaviorChanges: GitHub-comment markers (milestone-progress, stakeholder-question) emit the tautline prefix and parse BOTH the tautline and legacy minervit forms, so an already-posted block is found and replaced in place, never duplicated.
git rescue refs are created under tautline-local-rescue/, and the rescue-ref adapter-drift detector enumerates both tautline-local-rescue/ and legacy minervit-local-rescue/.

non-schema on-disk state paths (renderer-kit, methodology-rescue) default to ~/.local/state/tautline/ and read a pre-existing ~/.local/state/minervit/ location as a fallback. State-dir env-var override names are unchanged.

composeProjectPrefix default is now `tautline` (was `minervit`). BREAKING for adopters that rely on the default COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME: docker containers/volumes created under the old prefix are orphaned. Set composeProjectPrefix explicitly to the previous value to retain them. Company/domain/copyright stay Minervit.

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Markers, rescue refs, and state paths are read-both, so a rollback keeps resolving the legacy forms. The compose prefix reverts to `minervit`, orphaning any container created under `tautline` on 0.14.3 (the mirror of the forward orphaning).
grant-gh-project-scopes is carried forward from 0.10.3 (see requiredMigrations); a lane already on 0.10.3+ needs no action.
NOT WIP-safe: a lane relying on the default composeProjectPrefix while running docker compose would see its COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME change mid-work.
